Third-party files bundled so that bill reading works offline:
- tesseract.js and tesseract.js-core (Apache License 2.0) - https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- Tesseract language data eng (Apache License 2.0) - https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
- PDF.js (Apache License 2.0) - https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
